plain_description.what: Adds a debug setting that shuffles the order in which the tree builder considers splits and merges. It rebuilds the topic-labelled tree under 3 shuffled orders plus an unshuffled control. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: An audit flagged that the greedy builder may depend on processing order. This test measures how much.
plain_description.information: If order effects are as large as drawing a new data sample, the tree is fragile. If much smaller, the risk is bounded. Result: order dependence exists but is close to inert. Top-1 accuracy moves by only 0.25 points, against 2.6 points across data re-draws, and 85-86 of 86 leaves are recovered. Shown on the labelled tree only.
